mechanism_narrative: The unemployment rate (UNRATE) is always below 5.0% in the current economic cycle, and historically, unemployment rates below 5.0% have been associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, the S&P 500 produces negative returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals restrictive monetary policy combined with elevated inflation, increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.0% AND CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the number of employees (PAYEMS) exceeds 150,000 thousand, it indicates a strong labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 150000, the S&P 500 produces negative returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a strong labor market (PAYEMS > 150,000 thousand) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1400 thousand) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 150000 AND HOUST > 1400, the S&P 500 produces negative returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it indicates a contraction in the industrial sector, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, the S&P 500 produces positive returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 105), the S&P 500 produces positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO > 105, the S&P 500 produces negative returns in more than 40% of instances.
